package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func hybridApplicationFixture(t *testing.T) (StudentPlanningSnapshot, StudentLearningPath, HybridConsequence) {
	t.Helper()
	source, r := planningSnapshotFixture()
	future := source.Path.Items[0]
	future.ID = planningSnapshotID(100)
	future.Position = 2
	future.Status = LearningPathItemPlanned
	future.FrozenRequirements = append([]LessonRequirement{}, future.FrozenRequirements...)
	future.FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied = false
	source.Path.Items = append(source.Path.Items, future)
	s, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, r)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	scope := HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: append([]string{}, s.Profile.DesiredStacks...)}
	c := HybridConsequence{Schema: HybridConsequenceSchema, StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, SnapshotRef: s.References.SnapshotRef, SnapshotTargets: s.RequestedTargets, PolicyVersion: HybridReplanPolicyVersion, PolicyInputHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), Outcome: HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded, ApplicationMode: HybridApplicationAuto, ReasonCodes: []string{"TARGET_MASTERED_STABLE"}, BaselineScope: scope, DesiredScope: scope, Mutations: []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "SKIP_REDUNDANT_PENDING_ITEM", ItemID: future.ID}}}
	c.ConsequenceID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte("planner-hybrid-consequence.v1\x00"+c.StudentID+"\x00"+c.LearningPathID+"\x00"+c.SnapshotRef+"\x00"+c.PolicyVersion)).String()
	return s, source.Path, c
}
func TestHybridApplicationFutureSkipPreservesCurrentPrivateAssignment(t *testing.T) {
	s, path, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
	result, status, err := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, path, c, nil)
	if err != nil || status != HybridApplicationApplied || result.Version != path.Version+1 || result.Items[2].Status != LearningPathItemSkippedMastered || !reflect.DeepEqual(result.Items[:2], path.Items[:2]) || string(result.Items[0].LessonContent) != string(path.Items[0].LessonContent) {
		t.Fatalf("status=%s err=%v version=%d future=%s", status, err, result.Version, result.Items[2].Status)
	}
}
func TestHybridApplicationAutoCannotMutateCurrentExecution(t *testing.T) {
	s, path, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
	c.Mutations[0].ItemID = path.Items[1].ID
	_, _, err := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, path, c, nil)
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrHybridUnsafe) {
		t.Fatalf("current mutation accepted err=%v", err)
	}
}

func rehashHybridApplication(t *testing.T, s *StudentPlanningSnapshot, c *HybridConsequence) {
	t.Helper()
	var e error
	s.References, e = snapshotReferences(*s)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	c.SnapshotRef = s.References.SnapshotRef
	c.ConsequenceID = HybridConsequenceID(c.StudentID, c.LearningPathID, c.SnapshotRef, c.PolicyVersion)
}
func makeHybridApplicationIntent(t *testing.T, s *StudentPlanningSnapshot, c *HybridConsequence, kind string) *HybridLearningIntentProjection {
	t.Helper()
	intent := &HybridLearningIntentProjection{IntentID: planningSnapshotID(900), StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, Kind: kind, CreatedAt: s.CapturedAt, RequestedChange: HybridRequestedChange{Scope: c.DesiredScope, Mutations: cloneHybridApplicationMutations(c.Mutations)}}
	s.PendingIntent = intent
	c.ApplicationMode = HybridApplicationRequiresIntent
	c.IntentID = intent.IntentID
	c.RequiredIntentKind = kind
	c.ReasonCodes = []string{"EXPLICIT_LEARNER_INTENT", "REQUIRES_LEARNER_INTENT"}
	rehashHybridApplication(t, s, c)
	return intent
}
func TestHybridApplicationStaleAndTamperedConsequenceMatrix(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		change func(*StudentPlanningSnapshot, *StudentLearningPath, *HybridConsequence)
		want   error
	}{
		{"path revision", func(s *StudentPlanningSnapshot, p *StudentLearningPath, c *HybridConsequence) {
			c.ExpectedPathRevision++
		}, ErrHybridStale},
		{"snapshot reference", func(s *StudentPlanningSnapshot, p *StudentLearningPath, c *HybridConsequence) {
			c.SnapshotRef = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64)
			c.ConsequenceID = HybridConsequenceID(c.StudentID, c.LearningPathID, c.SnapshotRef, c.PolicyVersion)
		}, ErrHybridStale},
		{"foreign owner", func(s *StudentPlanningSnapshot, p *StudentLearningPath, c *HybridConsequence) {
			c.StudentID = planningSnapshotID(777)
			c.ConsequenceID = HybridConsequenceID(c.StudentID, c.LearningPathID, c.SnapshotRef, c.PolicyVersion)
		}, ErrHybridStale},
		{"changed private path projection", func(s *StudentPlanningSnapshot, p *StudentLearningPath, c *HybridConsequence) {
			p.Items[2].ReferenceID = planningSnapshotID(778)
		}, ErrHybridStale},
		{"changed scope", func(s *StudentPlanningSnapshot, p *StudentLearningPath, c *HybridConsequence) {
			c.BaselineScope.GoalCode = "other"
			c.DesiredScope.GoalCode = "other"
		}, ErrHybridStale},
		{"policy version", func(s *StudentPlanningSnapshot, p *StudentLearningPath, c *HybridConsequence) {
			c.PolicyVersion = "new-policy"
		}, ErrValidation},
		{"missing target coverage", func(s *StudentPlanningSnapshot, p *StudentLearningPath, c *HybridConsequence) {
			c.SnapshotTargets = c.SnapshotTargets[:1]
		}, ErrHybridStale},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
			tc.change(&s, &p, &c)
			before := cloneHybridPath(p)
			result, _, err := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil)
			if !errors.Is(err, tc.want) || !reflect.DeepEqual(result, before) {
				t.Fatalf("err=%v want=%v mutated=%v", err, tc.want, !reflect.DeepEqual(result, before))
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestHybridApplicationNoChangeIsReadOnlyAndOwnsPrivateBytes(t *testing.T) {
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
	c.Outcome = HybridOutcomeNoChange
	c.ApplicationMode = ""
	c.ReasonCodes = []string{"NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE"}
	c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{}
	result, status, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil)
	if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationNoChange || !reflect.DeepEqual(p, result) {
		t.Fatalf("status=%s err=%v", status, e)
	}
	result.Items[0].LessonContent[0] = 'x'
	result.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied = false
	result.Items[0].Targets[0].Key = "mutated"
	if p.Items[0].LessonContent[0] == 'x' || !p.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied || p.Items[0].Targets[0].Key == "mutated" {
		t.Fatal("result aliases private owner assignment")
	}
}
func TestHybridApplicationHistoryAndSatisfiedPendingAreProtected(t *testing.T) {
	for _, idx := range []int{0, 2} {
		t.Run(string(rune('a'+idx)), func(t *testing.T) {
			s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
			if idx == 2 {
				p.Items[2].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied = true
				s.Path.Items[2].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied = true
				rehashHybridApplication(t, &s, &c)
			}
			c.Mutations[0].ItemID = p.Items[idx].ID
			_, _, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil)
			if !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridUnsafe) {
				t.Fatalf("protected item err=%v", e)
			}
		})
	}
}
func hybridApplicationFourItems(t *testing.T) (StudentPlanningSnapshot, StudentLearningPath, HybridConsequence) {
	t.Helper()
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
	fourth := cloneHybridItem(p.Items[2])
	fourth.ID = planningSnapshotID(101)
	fourth.Position = 3
	p.Items = append(p.Items, fourth)
	w := s.Path.Items[2]
	w.ID = fourth.ID
	w.Position = 3
	w.FrozenRequirements = append([]LessonRequirement{}, w.FrozenRequirements...)
	s.Path.Items = append(s.Path.Items, w)
	rehashHybridApplication(t, &s, &c)
	return s, p, c
}
func TestHybridApplicationReorderPermutesFutureSlotsAndPreservesPrivateContent(t *testing.T) {
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFourItems(t)
	a, b := 3, 2
	c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS", ItemID: p.Items[2].ID, TargetPosition: &a}, {Kind: "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS", ItemID: p.Items[3].ID, TargetPosition: &b}}
	c.ReasonCodes = []string{"EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP"}
	result, status, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil)
	if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationApplied || result.Items[2].ID != p.Items[3].ID || result.Items[3].ID != p.Items[2].ID || !reflect.DeepEqual(result.Items[:2], p.Items[:2]) || string(result.Items[2].LessonContent) != string(p.Items[3].LessonContent) {
		t.Fatalf("status=%s err=%v", status, e)
	}
	c.Mutations = c.Mutations[:1]
	if _, _, e = ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil); !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("half permutation err=%v", e)
	}
}
func TestHybridApplicationMajorRequiresExactIntentAndWaitsDuringExecution(t *testing.T) {
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFourItems(t)
	a, b := 3, 2
	c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS", ItemID: p.Items[2].ID, TargetPosition: &a}, {Kind: "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS", ItemID: p.Items[3].ID, TargetPosition: &b}}
	intent := makeHybridApplicationIntent(t, &s, &c, "SUBSTANTIAL_SCOPE_CHANGE")
	if _, _, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil); !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridIntentRequired) {
		t.Fatalf("implicit intent err=%v", e)
	}
	result, status, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, intent)
	if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationWaitingSafeBoundary || !reflect.DeepEqual(result, p) {
		t.Fatalf("active boundary status=%s err=%v", status, e)
	}
	bad := *intent
	bad.IntentID = planningSnapshotID(999)
	if _, _, e = ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, &bad); !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridIntentRequired) {
		t.Fatalf("other intent err=%v", e)
	}
	s.CourseBindings = []PlanningCourseActionBinding{}
	s.PracticeBindings = []PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding{}
	s.Path.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemReady
	p.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemReady
	rehashHybridApplication(t, &s, &c)
	result, status, e = ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, intent)
	if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationApplied || result.Items[2].ID != p.Items[3].ID {
		t.Fatalf("safe matching intent status=%s err=%v", status, e)
	}
}
func TestHybridApplicationFrozenReplacementAndInsertionCloneTemplate(t *testing.T) {
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFourItems(t)
	p.Items[3].ReferenceID = planningSnapshotID(301)
	s.Path.Items[3].ReferenceID = p.Items[3].ReferenceID
	p.Items[3].LessonRevisionID = planningSnapshotID(302)
	s.Path.Items[3].LessonRevisionID = p.Items[3].LessonRevisionID
	p.Items[3].LessonContent = json.RawMessage(`{"private":"frozen template"}`)
	rehashHybridApplication(t, &s, &c)
	c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM", ItemID: p.Items[2].ID, TemplateItemID: p.Items[3].ID}}
	result, status, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil)
	if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationApplied || result.Items[2].ID != p.Items[2].ID || result.Items[2].ReferenceID != p.Items[3].ReferenceID || string(result.Items[2].LessonContent) != string(p.Items[3].LessonContent) {
		t.Fatalf("replacement status=%s err=%v", status, e)
	}
	pos := 3
	c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION", ItemID: p.Items[2].ID, TemplateItemID: p.Items[3].ID, NewItemID: planningSnapshotID(400), TargetPosition: &pos}}
	c.ReasonCodes = []string{"EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP"}
	result, status, e = ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil)
	if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationApplied || len(result.Items) != 5 || result.Items[3].ID != planningSnapshotID(400) || result.Items[4].ID != p.Items[3].ID || !reflect.DeepEqual(result.Items[:2], p.Items[:2]) {
		t.Fatalf("insertion status=%s err=%v len=%d", status, e, len(result.Items))
	}
	c.ReasonCodes = []string{"TARGET_MASTERED_STABLE"}
	if _, _, e = ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil); !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridUnsupported) {
		t.Fatalf("insertion without accepted gap err=%v", e)
	}
}
func TestHybridLearningIntentCreationMeaningScopeAndServerTimeReplay(t *testing.T) {
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
	intent := HybridLearningIntentProjection{IntentID: planningSnapshotID(500), StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, Kind: "CHANGE_GOAL", CreatedAt: s.CapturedAt, RequestedChange: HybridRequestedChange{Scope: HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: "go.advanced", DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}, Mutations: []HybridFutureMutation{}}}
	if e := ValidateHybridLearningIntentForCreation(s, p, intent); e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("meaningful scope proposal refused:%v", e)
	}
	hash, e := HybridLearningIntentPayloadHash(intent)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	intent.CreatedAt = intent.CreatedAt.Add(1000000000)
	again, e := HybridLearningIntentPayloadHash(intent)
	if e != nil || hash != again {
		t.Fatal("server clock destroyed idempotent request hash")
	}
	intent.RequestedChange.Scope.GoalCode = s.Path.GoalCode
	if e = ValidateHybridLearningIntentForCreation(s, p, intent); !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("noop accepted:%v", e)
	}
	intent.Kind = "CHANGE_TRACK"
	if e = ValidateHybridLearningIntentForCreation(s, p, intent); !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridUnsupported) {
		t.Fatalf("invented track accepted:%v", e)
	}
	_ = c
}
func TestHybridApplicationCrossScopeHasExplicitUnsupportedSafeBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
	s.CourseBindings = []PlanningCourseActionBinding{}
	s.PracticeBindings = []PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding{}
	s.Path.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemReady
	p.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemReady
	c.DesiredScope = HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: "go.advanced", DirectionCode: c.BaselineScope.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}
	c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{}
	intent := makeHybridApplicationIntent(t, &s, &c, "CHANGE_GOAL")
	result, _, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, intent)
	if !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridUnsupported) || !reflect.DeepEqual(result, p) {
		t.Fatalf("unmapped Course scope err=%v", e)
	}
}

func TestHybridApplicationInsertBatchIdentityAndMaximumPath(t *testing.T) {
	for _, count := range []int{498, 499} {
		t.Run(strconv.Itoa(count), func(t *testing.T) {
			s, p, c := hybridApplicationFourItems(t)
			for len(p.Items) < count {
				i := cloneHybridItem(p.Items[2])
				i.ID = planningSnapshotID(1000 + len(p.Items))
				i.Position = len(p.Items)
				p.Items = append(p.Items, i)
				w := s.Path.Items[2]
				w.ID = i.ID
				w.Position = i.Position
				w.FrozenRequirements = append([]LessonRequirement{}, w.FrozenRequirements...)
				s.Path.Items = append(s.Path.Items, w)
			}
			rehashHybridApplication(t, &s, &c)
			pos := 3
			c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION", ItemID: p.Items[2].ID, TemplateItemID: p.Items[2].ID, NewItemID: planningSnapshotID(8000), TargetPosition: &pos}, {Kind: "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION", ItemID: p.Items[3].ID, TemplateItemID: p.Items[3].ID, NewItemID: planningSnapshotID(8001), TargetPosition: &pos}}
			c.ReasonCodes = []string{"EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP"}
			result, status, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil)
			if count == 498 {
				if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationApplied || len(result.Items) != 500 {
					t.Fatalf("exact ceiling status=%s err=%v len=%d", status, e, len(result.Items))
				}
			} else {
				if !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridConflict) || len(result.Items) != 499 {
					t.Fatalf("overflow accepted err=%v len=%d", e, len(result.Items))
				}
			}
			c.Mutations[1].NewItemID = c.Mutations[0].NewItemID
			if _, _, e = ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil); !errors.Is(e, ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("duplicate identity err=%v", e)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestHybridApplicationLegacyNilPrivateAssignmentRemainsExact(t *testing.T) {
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
	p.Items[0].LessonRevisionID = ""
	p.Items[0].FrozenRequirements = nil
	s.Path.Items[0].LessonRevisionID = ""
	s.Path.Items[0].FrozenRequirements = []LessonRequirement{}
	s.ActivityFacts = []PlanningSnapshotActivityFact{}
	rehashHybridApplication(t, &s, &c)
	result, status, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil)
	if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationApplied || !reflect.DeepEqual(result.Items[0], p.Items[0]) {
		t.Fatalf("legacy assignment changed status=%s err=%v", status, e)
	}
}

func TestHybridApplicationExactIntentCanReplaceUnstartedReadyAtSafeBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
	s.CourseBindings = []PlanningCourseActionBinding{}
	s.PracticeBindings = []PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding{}
	p.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemReady
	s.Path.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemReady
	c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", ItemID: p.Items[1].ID, TemplateItemID: p.Items[2].ID}}
	intent := makeHybridApplicationIntent(t, &s, &c, "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY")
	result, status, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, intent)
	if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationApplied || result.Items[1].ID != p.Items[1].ID || result.Items[1].Position != p.Items[1].Position || result.Items[1].Status != LearningPathItemReady || result.Items[1].LessonRevisionID != p.Items[2].LessonRevisionID || string(result.Items[1].LessonContent) != string(p.Items[2].LessonContent) || !reflect.DeepEqual(result.Items[0], p.Items[0]) {
		t.Fatalf("safe active replacement status=%s err=%v", status, e)
	}
	p.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemInProgress
	s.Path.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemInProgress
	rehashHybridApplication(t, &s, &c)
	result, status, e = ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, intent)
	if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationWaitingSafeBoundary || !reflect.DeepEqual(result, p) {
		t.Fatalf("started current replacement status=%s err=%v", status, e)
	}
}

func TestHybridApplicationRejectsOmittedOwnerTargetScope(t *testing.T) {
	for _, surface := range []string{"path", "course binding", "practice binding"} {
		t.Run(surface, func(t *testing.T) {
			s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
			extra := LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.omitted-owner-target", Version: "v1"}
			switch surface {
			case "path":
				p.Items[2].Targets = append(p.Items[2].Targets, extra)
				sortPlanningTargets(p.Items[2].Targets)
				s.Path.Items[2].Targets = append([]LearningTargetRef{}, p.Items[2].Targets...)
			case "course binding":
				s.CourseBindings[0].LearningTargets = append(s.CourseBindings[0].LearningTargets, extra)
				sortPlanningTargets(s.CourseBindings[0].LearningTargets)
			case "practice binding":
				s.PracticeBindings[0].LearningTargets = append(s.PracticeBindings[0].LearningTargets, extra)
				sortPlanningTargets(s.PracticeBindings[0].LearningTargets)
			}
			rehashHybridApplication(t, &s, &c)
			if _, e := NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot(s); e != nil {
				t.Fatalf("regression requires otherwise valid coherent subset snapshot: %v", e)
			}
			_, _, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil)
			if !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridStale) {
				t.Fatalf("omitted %s target was accepted for application: %v", surface, e)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestHybridLearningIntentRecordsMeaningfulCancelWithoutFabricatingTransition(t *testing.T) {
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
	s.CourseBindings = []PlanningCourseActionBinding{}
	s.PracticeBindings = []PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding{}
	p.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemReady
	s.Path.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemReady
	c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", ItemID: p.Items[1].ID}}
	intent := makeHybridApplicationIntent(t, &s, &c, "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY")
	if e := ValidateHybridLearningIntentForCreation(s, p, *intent); e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("meaningful explicit cancel cannot be recorded: %v", e)
	}
	result, _, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, intent)
	if !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridUnsupported) || !reflect.DeepEqual(result, p) {
		t.Fatalf("unsupported cancellation fabricated state err=%v", e)
	}
}

func TestHybridLearningIntentCancelRecordingRejectsNoncurrentAndMalformedScope(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []LearningPathItemStatus{LearningPathItemPlanned, LearningPathItemCompleted, LearningPathItemSkippedMastered} {
		t.Run(string(status), func(t *testing.T) {
			s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
			s.CourseBindings = []PlanningCourseActionBinding{}
			s.PracticeBindings = []PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding{}
			p.Items[1].Status = status
			s.Path.Items[1].Status = status
			c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", ItemID: p.Items[1].ID}}
			intent := makeHybridApplicationIntent(t, &s, &c, "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY")
			if e := ValidateHybridLearningIntentForCreation(s, p, *intent); !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridUnsafe) {
				t.Fatalf("cancel recorded against %s:%v", status, e)
			}
		})
	}
	s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
	c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", ItemID: p.Items[1].ID}}
	c.DesiredScope = HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: "other.goal", DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}
	intent := makeHybridApplicationIntent(t, &s, &c, "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY")
	if e := ValidateHybridLearningIntentForCreation(s, p, *intent); !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("cancel smuggled scope change:%v", e)
	}
}

func TestHybridApplicationMatchedInactiveNoChangeAcknowledgesWithoutMutation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, state := range []LearningPathStatus{LearningPathStatusPaused, LearningPathStatusCompleted, LearningPathStatusArchived} {
		t.Run(string(state), func(t *testing.T) {
			s, p, c := hybridApplicationFixture(t)
			p.Status = state
			p.IsPrimary = false
			s.Path.Status = state
			s.Path.IsPrimary = false
			rehashHybridApplication(t, &s, &c)
			replan := c
			c.Outcome = HybridOutcomeNoChange
			c.ApplicationMode = ""
			c.Mutations = []HybridFutureMutation{}
			c.ReasonCodes = []string{"NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE"}
			if _, e := NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot(s); e != nil {
				t.Fatalf("regression needs valid coherent inactive owner snapshot: %v", e)
			}
			result, status, e := ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, c, nil)
			if e != nil || status != HybridApplicationNoChange || !reflect.DeepEqual(result, p) || result.Version != p.Version {
				t.Fatalf("matched %s NO_CHANGE refused status=%s err=%v", state, status, e)
			}
			_, _, e = ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s, p, replan, nil)
			if !errors.Is(e, ErrHybridUnsafe) {
				t.Fatalf("inactive REPLAN accepted: %v", e)
			}
		})
	}
}
